description: Reads one domain's own sitemap.xml and RSS or Atom feeds (robots.txt respected) and returns its pages as a table with URL, title, description, last modified date and HTTP status. Filter by keyword, URL text or date. If the site has no usable sitemap, it returns Google links instead.

folders.description: Include a count of pages per top folder

keywords.description: Keep pages whose URL or title contains all words of any keyword

older_than.description: Keep pages last modified before YYYY-MM-DD

page_details.description: For this many top rows, fetch the page for HTTP status, title and description

since.description: Keep pages modified on or after YYYY-MM-DD

subdomains.description: Also read these subdomains, for example docs or help

target.description: A domain or folder, for example competitor.com or competitor.com/blog/

url_contains.description: Keep pages whose URL path contains any of these, for example /blog/ or case-stud

name: site-inventory
title: List a site's pages from its sitemap
